## Context / Problem
`pytest-split==0.11.0` is pinned (`pyproject.toml:274`) but `.test_durations` is git-ignored as "never committed" (`.gitignore:64-65`, task 9ad9), so no duration profile exists for splitting the suite or for the AGENTS.md 20-25 minute `make verify` budget. This story runs last in the epic so the profile covers the final suite after S1-S4. Line numbers re-checked on origin/main 6080140e7af (2026-10-26); the earlier cites were from an old commit.

## Approach
1. Remove the `.test_durations` entry and its comment (`.gitignore:64-65`).
2. Add `\.test_durations` to the `check-added-large-files` `exclude` (`.pre-commit-config.yaml:33`, now `^uv\.lock$`), making it `^(uv\.lock|\.test_durations)$`, and extend the comment above it (the 500 KB default cap would reject the file).
3. Record the profile in the SAME run as the pre-push gate. `make test` runs exactly `pytest -m "not integration and not external" -n 4 --dist worksteal -q` (`Makefile:568`), so `PYTEST_ADDOPTS="--store-durations --clean-durations --durations-path=$PWD/.rebar/scratch/test_durations.json" make verify` from the repo root writes the profile and gives the `make verify` result in one pass (about 60 min), instead of two full suites, and `cp` then installs it as `.test_durations`. The default path cannot be used: a first attempt at 2026-10-26 00:11 PDT wrote `.test_durations` in the checkout and the repo-isolation backstop (`tests/_isolation.py:150`) failed the session with `?? .test_durations`; once the file is tracked a refresh would show as modified and fail the same way. `.rebar/*` is git-ignored. An xdist dry run with the custom path stored 61 keys for 61 tests. A clean `make lint typecheck import-convention` is a precondition, because `make verify` stops at the first failing prerequisite before `test` and then no profile is written (it ran green: exit 0). pytest-split writes it on the controller's `pytest_sessionfinish` from `terminalreporter.stats` (`pytest_split/plugin.py:188-223`), keyed by node id for every test report with a non-negative duration, so the xdist workers' reports and skipped tests are included. The 17 known pandoc failures also get keys.
4. Commit `.test_durations` (sorted JSON, indent 4; size recorded on the ticket).
5. Add `### Per-test durations (.test_durations)` to `docs/local-dev-env.md` after the "Sandboxed agent hosts" section and before `### The per-test hang budget` (the "Day-to-day gates" heading is at line 495): the command above and why it writes to `.rebar/` and copies, that the file is refreshed by a deliberate re-run only, that durations are one run's wall-clock times on a loaded host (use them as relative weights, not as a budget), and `pytest --splits N --group K` usage.

6. Exempt the profile from the criteria-vocabulary gate. Found at 2026-10-26 01:20 PDT when `pre-commit run --all-files` failed in the `lint` hook: `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py` scans every tracked text file and flagged 19 lines of `.test_durations` whose test node ids quote retired vocabulary (tests such as `test_migrate_success_criteria_heldout.py` exercise that migration). Add `Path(".test_durations")` to its `EXCLUDED_FILES` (precedent: `scripts/build_cloud_adf_corpus.py`; an allowlist row would need an exact count and break on every refresh) and add the path to the parametrized `test_explicitly_excluded_paths_are_not_scanned`. That case fails before the script change and passes after. The added case is a new node id, so the profile is recorded after it.

7. Allow the profile in the stale bridge-vocabulary guard. Found at the end of the third combined run (it ended about 02:10 PDT on 2026-10-26) (18 failed, 1 outside the known pandoc set): `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py::test_no_uncategorized_live_old_spelling` scans every tracked text file for the retired command names (`bridge-status`, `jira-onboard`, ...) and flagged `.test_durations`, whose node ids quote them. Add `".test_durations"` to its `_WHOLE_FILE_ALLOWLIST` (the same path-allowlist the file already uses for other files that legitimately quote the names). Red, about 02:17 PDT: with the profile staged and the allowlist unchanged the test fails (1 failed, 8 passed); with the entry it passes (9 passed). To avoid a third surprise I also ran the full `make lint` (exit 0) and the other 20 test modules that read tracked files repo-wide with the profile staged: 274 passed, 1 failed (this one).

Known caveat (already on this ticket): the held-out merge epic traitorous-official-sunbittern (still open) renames or merges about 170 modules, which invalidates keys; its story awake-shoddy-gyrfalcon re-runs the same command at the end. Out of scope here.

## Scope
In scope: `.gitignore`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `.test_durations` (new), `docs/local-dev-env.md`, `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py` and its test `tests/unit/test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py` (one parameter case), and `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py` (one allowlist entry). Out of scope: any CI workflow that consumes the profile (`--splits`/`--group` is not wired into CI), `pyproject.toml`, the `Makefile`, and every other test module. No key-count ratchet is added: it would go stale with the merge epic.

## Red proof (before the change)
`git ls-files .test_durations` prints nothing; with the file present and the `exclude` unchanged, `pre-commit run check-added-large-files --files .test_durations` FAILS (over the 500 KB cap); after step 2 it passes.

## Testing
After the run: key count `python -c "import json;print(len(json.load(open('.test_durations'))))"`; collected count `pytest --collect-only -q -m "not integration and not external" | tail -1`; nodes collected without a key and keys not collected are both counted and explained (target 0 each, since `--clean-durations` drops absent nodes); `pytest --splits 4 --group K --collect-only -q -m "not integration and not external"` for K=1..4: the four counts sum to the collected count and the four estimated durations printed by pytest-split are each within 5% of a quarter of the total recorded time (groups are balanced by duration, so their test COUNTS differ, which a first draft of this plan got wrong); `pre-commit run --all-files` green; `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` green. Record the four counts, the file size and the host load on this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `.test_durations` is tracked (`git ls-files .test_durations` prints it), and the number of collected nodes with no key and of keys with no collected node are each recorded and explained (target 0), with the key count and collected count on this ticket.
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` accepts the file, and `pre-commit run check-added-large-files --files .test_durations` fails when the `exclude` change is reverted (red proof recorded).
- [ ] The `### Per-test durations (.test_durations)` section exists in `docs/local-dev-env.md` and `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` passes.
- [ ] For K=1..4, `pytest --splits 4 --group K --collect-only -q -m "not integration and not external"` collects counts that sum to the collected count, and the four estimated durations are each within 5% of a quarter of the total recorded time (counts and estimates recorded on this ticket).
- [ ] `python scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py` exits 0 with `.test_durations` tracked, and the new exclusion case in `tests/unit/test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py` fails without the `EXCLUDED_FILES` entry and passes with it (both runs recorded on this ticket).
- [ ] `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py` passes with `.test_durations` tracked, and fails without its allowlist entry (both runs recorded on this ticket).
- [ ] `make verify` shows no failure outside the known pandoc set, and the Gerrit change is `Verified +1`.
